entries.mitigation: Tank faces the cone away from the group; everyone else stays behind or well outside the breath lane.
Control and separate broodlings cleanly. Do not let add movement drag the group through fire patches or the boss cone.
Spread in different directions and kite personal beams away from one another until they expire, then regroup.
Respect sickle travel paths and use the corpse-burst interaction deliberately instead of letting bodies and projectiles clutter the arena.
Chain or stack adds where possible and burn them before add pressure overlaps the next sickle cycle.
Avoid waking or killing extra gargoyles when the group does not need to. Preserve the room instead of turning every statue into another enemy.
Block heavy hits and keep Talfyg faced away from the group so basic tank pressure does not become raid damage.
Control the Blood Guardian without letting it destabilize boss positioning. If pursuing Guardian Preserved, manage it rather than killing it.
Use the Blood Scavenger synergy during the swarm transition, complete the mechanic, then regroup promptly on Lady Thorn.
Interrupt immediately. Missing the short interrupt window causes severe resource drain and resource reduction.
Block the targeted charge instead of trying to outrun it at the last second.
Prepare mitigation and healing for the burst, then remove Stone Husk pressure quickly before the next elemental cycle compounds it.
Spread so personal lightning circles do not overlap and block as the Behemoth punches the floor.

entries.entry_name: Stone Husk Control — Arkasis the Mad Alchemist
entries.mitigation: During Werewolf Behemoth phases, use Bonecrusher to interrupt Stone Husks and use the transformation kit rather than ordinary human rotation habits.

entries.entry_name: Lightning AoE — Arkasis the Mad Alchemist
entries.mitigation: Kite the mobile shock field, free pinned players with the synergy, and do not drag the field through teammates.
